title: Properties of the category of quasi-coherent modules on the small etale site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma records six closure properties of QCoh(S_etale, O): direct sums, arbitrary colimits, kernels and cokernels, the two-out-of-three property for short exact sequences, tensor products, and internal homs of a finitely presented sheaf (statement lines 3426-3448). The proof transfers each property from the corresponding statement for quasi-coherent modules on the scheme S, using the limits lemma for the equivalence F -> F^a: each part writes the involved sheaves as G_i^a or as reductions of arrows, rewrites the operation in question as the operation on the G's followed by (-)^a, and concludes. Part (6) additionally uses the properties lemma to see that finite presentability is preserved along the equivalence (proof lines 3450-3511). The level is H3: six statements, each with its own displayed reduction, and the transfer principle is applied rather than merely asserted.
